days.title: フォンニャ洞窟
days.morning: Arrive in Phong Nha and take a boat along the Son river into Phong Nha and Tien Son caves.
days.evening: Phong Nha grilled chicken and a riverside homestay.

days.title: ティエンドゥオン洞窟 – ダーク洞窟
days.morning: Explore Paradise Cave and its magnificent stalactites.
days.afternoon: Zipline, mud bath at Dark Cave and swim in the Chay river.
days.evening: Try Quang Binh bánh bột lọc and noodle porridge.

days.title: ヌオックモック渓流 – チャングエン
days.morning: Nuoc Mooc stream – swimming and kayaking in the jungle.
days.afternoon: Tam Co cave and the legendary Ho Chi Minh Trail.
days.evening: BBQ at the homestay and stories from cave explorers.

days.title: ドンホイ – ニャットレービーチ
days.morning: Back to Dong Hoi: the old citadel and Tam Toa church.
days.afternoon: Swim at Nhat Le and visit Quang Phu sand dunes.
days.evening: Seafood at Dong Hoi night market.

days.title: ヴンチュア – イエン島
days.morning: Visit General Vo Nguyen Giap's grave at Vung Chua – Yen Island.
days.afternoon: Swim at Da Nhay beach and buy sweet potato candy.
days.evening: Stroll the Nhat Le riverside square.
